description: Checks Crosodo's 43-food × 51-jurisdiction 'Can I Sell This?' dataset for a specific food and US state: returns verdict (yes | conditional | no), state statute citation, food-safety rationale (pH / water activity), and whether Rung 3 (Inspected Kitchen) is required. No auth required. Cottage food laws change. This summary is generated from Crosodo's hand-maintained dataset — it is not legal advice. Verify with your county before selling.

food.description: Food name or slug, e.g. 'sourdough-bread', 'cookies', 'cream cheese frosting', 'cheesecake'

state.description: 2-letter USPS state abbrev (e.g. VA, TX, CA) or state name/slug

name: check_food_legality
title: Check if a food can be sold from home in a US state
